userStories.title: Give the source_verify literal grammar its own seam on SourceVerifier
userStories.description: As an LCA maintainer, I want the literal-extraction grammar (which literals count as verifiable) to be an injectable seam on SourceVerifier instead of a module-private regex, so grammar evolution and grammar tests do not require touching verdict logic.
acceptanceCriteria: A named seam (e.g. LiteralExtractor protocol or constructor-injected callable) exists for literal extraction; SourceVerifier._judge_claim uses it instead of the module-private _extract_literals
Default implementation preserves the current _LITERAL grammar exactly (verdict semantics unchanged; ADR-0255 4.8 hallucination verdicts intact)
The grammar is unit-testable without building a SourceRegistry (direct tests on the extractor, e.g. Chinese date forms, 4-char identifier boundary)
tests/infrastructure/source_verify/ all green; ruff check clean on touched files

userStories.title: Derive the session event-type closure fully; drop the hand-written DSH literal
userStories.description: As an LCA maintainer, I want known_session_event_types() to union only registered vocabularies, so the fail-closed read path never depends on a human remembering to edit catalog.py when the DSH surface vocabulary grows.
acceptanceCriteria: The DSH surface vocabulary (currently the hand-written "surface/developer_message") lives in one named constant (single source) next to the other surface vocabularies
lca/session/catalog.py contains no hand-written event-type literals; known_session_event_types() is a pure union of registered vocabularies
known_session_event_types() return set unchanged; tests/observability/session/test_known_types_fail_closed.py and tests/session/test_session_public_api.py green; ruff check clean
